fix_subject: Fix validity maske size for arrow conversion
pr_title: This fixes two bugs in reading Arrow arrays that hold a dictionary

labels.summary: Reading a dictionary-encoded Arrow array with nulls used a validity mask sized for a standard vector, so batches larger than that overflowed it, and the validity was read from the wrong nested offset instead of the same offset as the indices.
